claims.author: Claudius Ptolemy / J.M. Ashmand trans.
claims.edition: Ashmand 1822; Gutenberg ebook 70850

claims.original_claim: Mercury is of common influence, good or evil in unison with whatever planets he is connected with.
claims.normalized_claim: Mercury takes colour from what it joins

claims.author: Joanna Watters
claims.edition: Astrology For Today 2003, Carroll & Brown; Skyscript republication

claims.author: Liz Greene / Howard Sasportas
claims.edition: The Inner Planets, 1993 Samuel Weiser; ISBN 0-87728-741-4
claims.locus: The Inner Planets Pt.1 Mercury section (Greene/Sasportas)
claims.original_claim: Via the myth of newborn Hermes setting off without knowing where he was headed, Mercury is linked to spontaneity and openness to the unplanned.
claims.normalized_claim: Mercury linked (via young-Hermes myth) to spontaneity and openness to the unexpected.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Mercury, Weaver of the Threads of Life
claims.original_claim: The weaver of this pattern of relationship is, in astrological symbolism, Mercury. The many beings within Saturnian Law come to realize they belong together as aspects of one tribal Whole.
claims.normalized_claim: Mercury = weaver of the pattern of relationship that makes the Saturn-bounded group one Whole.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Mercury, Weaver of the Threads of Life
claims.original_claim: Saturn's structural framework is imposed from without. Mercury's pattern of relationship grows from the inside as the cells interrelate; it must conform to Saturn's frame yet may grow with relative freedom.
claims.normalized_claim: Saturn = outer structural frame; Mercury = inner-grown pattern of relationship within that frame.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Mercury, Weaver of the Threads of Life
claims.original_claim: Physiologically Saturn is the skeleton; Mercury is the nervous system, following the generic bony structure yet capable of individual variation. Individual consciousness is the accruing synthesis of those relations.
claims.normalized_claim: Mercury analogue: nervous system — organic interrelationship whose synthesis is individual consciousness.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Mercury, Weaver of the Threads of Life
claims.original_claim: Roads, canals, railways, telegraph, telephone, and radio are the nervous system of the national organism: lines of communication growing from the desire to associate.
claims.normalized_claim: Mercury theme: lines of communication (commerce, travel, media) as the organism's interrelationship.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Mercury, Weaver of the Threads of Life
claims.original_claim: Mercury is the servant or messenger of Jupiter. First he is the power of organic inter-relationship (receive and transmit sensation); later, the power of thought-association and the substance of mind.
claims.normalized_claim: Mercury serves Jupiter: first organic inter-relationship; later thought-association as the substance of mind.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Mercury, Weaver of the Threads of Life
claims.original_claim: Mercury is progressively liberated from Saturn when Uranus challenges Saturnian authority and world-civilization supersedes local cultures; communication is then no longer limited by the geographical frame.
claims.normalized_claim: Mercury can outgrow Saturn's local frame when Uranus challenges it; communication then exceeds geography.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Mercury, Weaver of the Threads of Life
claims.original_claim: In Tibetan astrology Mercury (Lhagpa) is a Hand. The five-fingered Hand gives birth to culture; it is the visible Mercury of Jupiter's mind-ego while processes remain tribal.
claims.normalized_claim: Mercury as Hand: culture-making agency of relationship, not yet individual rational mind.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Mercury, Weaver of the Threads of Life
claims.original_claim: As man functions as an individual at the psycho-mental level, Mercury operates on two planes: behind the Hand stands the rational mind, until the mind evolves its own Hand.
claims.normalized_claim: Later Mercury: two planes — bodily Hand and rational mind, until mind has its own Hand.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Mercury, Weaver of the Threads of Life
claims.original_claim: The essential Mercury realm is pure organic relationship or operative Wholeness. Force is the product of relationship; the absolutely unrelated unit is the symbol of absolute powerlessness.
claims.normalized_claim: Mercury = operative Wholeness: relationship as the source of force; unrelatedness is powerlessness.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Mercury, Weaver of the Threads of Life
claims.original_claim: He who emphasizes separateness and denies love is essentially powerless and must make a show of outer power: the only relationship he accepts is hunter to prey.
claims.normalized_claim: Mercury shadow: separateness/denial of love yields powerlessness, then hunter-prey relatedness.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Mercury, Weaver of the Threads of Life
claims.original_claim: The caduceus is the hieroglyph of Mercury the Master-Weaver: central rod and intertwining serpents as centralized rhythmic relationship. Mercury is the giver of understanding and revealer of significance.
claims.normalized_claim: Constructive Mercury: caduceus as Master-Weaver; giver of understanding / revealer of significance.

claims.author: Dane Rudhyar
claims.edition: New Mansions for New Men, Lucis Press 1938; Khaldea archival ed. 2008
claims.locus: Pt.2 Music of the Spheres — Mercury, Weaver of the Threads of Life
claims.original_claim: If Saturn's law becomes a hard shell, Mercury is cut in twain: the individual is no longer of one mind, rent by mental conflicts. Mercury is a servant, at times treacherous; it synthesizes whatever it is given.
claims.normalized_claim: Mercury shadow if Saturn hardens: mind split in two; a servant that can treacherously synthesize discord.
